### Capture the blur task state (1/2)

**Severity:** `high`

A monitor handle can be removed and re-added while its earlier blur is still running. Capture the current state instance when scheduling the task so the completion code can distinguish that old task from work belonging to the replacement state.

```suggestion
            _ = Task.Run(() => this.RunBlur(screenInfo, state, screenshotImage));
```

proposed_comments.body:
### Retain the writer failure (1/5)

**Severity:** `high`

When a writer throws, the only consumer currently faults and subsequent Flush waits indefinitely for a signal it can no longer process. Retain the first failure so the consumer can keep draining completion signals and report that failure at Flush or shutdown.

```suggestion
    private Exception? writerFailure;
    private bool writingPaused;
```

Apply every suggestion in this numbered group together; individual members are not complete fixes.

proposed_comments.title: Require every requested input event to be inserted

confidence.rationale: Native count contract and source predicate establish that positive returned counts below pInputs.Length are currently accepted. Exact literal suggestion compiles independently and with the full candidate. No live input injection was performed.

proposed_comments.body:
### Require every requested input event to be inserted

**Severity:** `medium`

SendInput returns an inserted-event count, not a Boolean. A positive count smaller than pInputs.Length currently passes SuccessIsNonZero, so this wrapper loses the native partial-failure signal; require a nonzero count equal to the requested count, preserving both zero-return failure and the returned count/last error on failure.

```suggestion
        var result = PInvoke.SendInput(pInputs, cbSize);
        return result != 0 && result == (uint)pInputs.Length
            ? new Win32Result<uint>(result, success: true)
            : new Win32Result<uint>(result, success: false, lastError: Marshal.GetLastPInvokeError());
```
